name: jinzteamspeak
description: TeamSpeak web client: voice, chat, web-to-web video/screen share, and a native song-request panel for teamspeak-music-bot

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n protocol,hub,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:dev -w packages/protocol" "npm:dev -w apps/hub" "npm:dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/protocol && npm run build -w apps/hub && npm run build -w apps/web
